_comment: Contract events: betrayals, bribes, double-crosses. They only fire while you hold the matching contract. See docs/events.md.

target_bribe.title: A letter from the owners
target_bribe.text: A boat brings a letter: the owners of the ship you were hired to take have heard you're coming. They offer 300 gold to look the other way.

choices.text: Take the money and drop the job
choices.result: Easy money. Your employer won't see it that way.

choices.text: Take the money and do the job anyway
choices.result: Business is business. The story will get around.

dispatch_thief.title: A thief in the night
dispatch_thief.text: You wake to a figure at your sea chest, where the dispatches are locked. He bolts for the companionway.

choices.result: You catch him at the rail. The seals are unbroken; he'll talk to the governor.
choices.fail_result: He's over the side with the packet. The dispatches are gone.

choices.result: The watch corners him in the waist.
choices.fail_result: Too slow. He's gone, and so are the dispatches.

rival_on_the_job.title: Another hunter
rival_on_the_job.text: A pirate sloop is shadowing you. A man on her deck shouts across: 'That prize is ours, mate. We were hired first!'

choices.result: Only one of you is collecting.
He agrees and sheers off. You'll owe him a drink.

customs_tipped.title: A warning from the broker's man
customs_tipped.text: A fishing boat comes alongside. The broker's man aboard says customs know what you're carrying. Someone talked.

choices.text: Dump the contraband and give up the run
choices.result: Better a broken promise than a hanging.
You'll trust to luck, and to darkness.

broker_squeeze.title: The broker's men
broker_squeeze.text: Two of the broker's men come aboard in {port} with a new demand: a bigger cut, paid now, or the deal's off and they'll let your name slip to the authorities.

choices.result: They count it twice and leave.
They swim ashore. The broker sends an apology the next day.
choices.fail_result: They make good on the threat.

hunter_hired.title: A price on your head
hunter_hired.text: A tavern keeper in {port} warns you quietly: a merchant you robbed has hired a pirate hunter, and he's already at sea looking for you.

choices.text: Lie low here for a while
choices.result: Five quiet days. Perhaps he'll look elsewhere.
Better to choose the time and place yourself.

hunter_found.title: The hunter
hunter_found.text: There he is: a {nation_adj} hunter, cleared for action, beating up toward you.

choices.result: You know these waters better than he does, you hope.

employer_gift.title: A token of thanks
employer_gift.text: The governor of {port} sends a case of fine wine aboard, with his compliments, for your good service.

choices.result: Fine claret at the captain's table.
Too good for the likes of you.
